title: Three one-use sets are not size-bounded
evidence: 2026-11-26 done (US-52 AC16), each bounded at 50,000 through boundedMap: app-gate.server.ts appLimits.challenges forgets its oldest entry at the bound, as the other limit maps do; mcp-grants.server.ts spentCodes (oneUse) refuses new redemptions while every id held is live; spentProposals (oneUse) at the bound holds no new key and the shared claim store decides. spentWrites is not a one-use set: the per-connection write allowance, keyed by authenticated connections, stays on UNBOUNDED_TTL (owner ruling). 2026-11-25 done: supabase-guest.server.ts guestIpRateMap is now createRateLimiter 'guest sessions per IP' (50,000 keys); chat-customer-cache.server.ts orderCache is on boundedMap, 10,000 keys (US-15 AC67). (lab-batches.server.ts activeBatches and undeletedBatches went with the batch path, 2026-11-15.) From the PR 1613 review
